title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. Adding a new feature can affect this variance.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially a polynomial feature like the square of an existing feature, it can increase the model's complexity.

title: Complexity and Variance
text: Increasing the complexity of a model by adding features generally increases the model variance. This is because the model can fit the training data more closely, but may not generalize well to new data.
